# SIRUP

> Spatial Immune Receptor Utilities Package. A consolidated toolkit for long-read spatial immune receptor sequencing. SIRUP takes demultiplexed reads from the companion 'RRAD' package and runs an end-to-end IgBLAST and pRESTO pipeline to produce AIRR-style rearrangement tables with spatial IDs and coordinates. It also provides Visium HD barcode mapping, clonal summaries, tree plotting, polygon annotation, and spatial statistics.

Source: https://github.com/hoehnlab/SIRUP - License: MIT + file LICENSE

All links point at raw files in the GitHub repo, not the readthedocs site,
so any agent that can fetch a URL can read them directly.

## Function reference

All URLs share the prefix https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoehnlab/SIRUP/main/docs/topics/ (e.g. `fn` -> `.../topics/fn.md`).

### Processing
- `addSequenceQualityMetrics`: Add quality measures to an AIRR table
- `addTissuePositions`: Add tissue coordinates to an AIRR table
- `collapseIdenticalNeighbors`: Collapse neighboring spots with identical receptor sequences
- `collapseTopConsensusPerSpatialId`: Keep the most abundant consensus sequence of each spatial ID and locus
- `extractSpatialIds`: Extract spatial IDs from sequence IDs
- `filterAirr`: Filter AIRR sequences
- `parseRadSequenceIds`: Split the rrad tags out of sequence IDs
- `processSpatialSample`: Process one spatial sample from reads to an AIRR table
- `processSpatialSamples`: Process several spatial samples
- `readSpatialIdMapping`: Read a spatial ID mapping file
- `runIgblast`: Annotate raw reads with IgBLAST
- `spatialReceptorSummary`: Count the sequences and spots of a receptor table
- `writeFastqas`: Write sequences to a FASTQ or FASTA file

### SIRUP io
- `sirup-io`: Save and read SIRUP objects

### SIRUP object
- `createSIRUP`: Create a SIRUP object
- `isSIRUP`: Test whether an object is a SIRUP object
- `mergeSIRUP`: Merge SIRUP objects into one multi-sample object
- `sirup-accessors`: Extract data from a SIRUP object
- `sirup-analyses`: Store and retrieve analyses in a SIRUP object
- `sirup-polygons`: Add or retrieve polygon geometry from a SIRUP object
- `sirup-transform`: Update data stored in a SIRUP object
- `subsetSIRUP`: Subset a SIRUP object
- `validateSIRUP`: Validate a SIRUP object

### SIRUP trees
- `assignTipColors`: Assign colors to the tips of clones
- `chooseTreeTipK`: Choose the number of tip clusters for a tree
- `clusterTreesTips`: Cluster the tips of all trees in a dowser result
- `clusterTreeTips`: Cluster the tips of a tree
- `formatSpatialClones`: Format the receptors of a SIRUP object as in dowser's formatClones()
- `getSpatialTrees`: Build trees from the formatted clones of a SIRUP object
- `tipPatristicMatrix`: Calculate patristic distances between tips in a tree

### Spatial ggplot visualization
- `plotLengthQc`: Plot length histograms of V, J, and junction regions
- `plotReceptors`: Plot receptor groups on a tissue image
- `plotReceptorsExpression`: Plot receptor groups over gene expression
- `plotSpatialCloneColorTips`: Plot the tip colors of one clone on a tissue image
- `plotSpatialCloneTreePairs`: Plot each clone tree next to its tissue map
- `plotSpatialColorTips`: Plot tip colors on a tissue image
- `sirupSampleFromImage`: Get the sample name from an image label
- `spatialCloneTreePairsToPDF`: Save the tree and map pairs to a PDF file
- `spatialDiscretePlot`: Plot a metadata column on a tissue image
- `spatialExpressionBlendPlot`: Blend the expression of two features on a tissue image
- `spatialExpressionMultiPlot`: Plot several features as ordered color layers
- `spatialExpressionPlot`: Plot gene expression on a tissue image

### Spatial polygons
- `assignReceptorPolygons`: Add polygon IDs to a receptor table
- `assignSpatialPolygons`: Add polygon IDs to the spatial metadata
- `expandPolygons`: Expand polygons outward from their centroids
- `formatSpatialPolygons`: Format point sets as polygon vertices
- `plotSpatialCloneDensity3D`: Plot 3D clone-density surfaces on a tissue image
- `plotSpatialPolygonPies`: Plot clonal dominance results within polygons as pies or bars
- `plotSpatialPolygons`: Plot polygons on a tissue image
- `plotSpatialRegionReceptors`: Plot receptors inside polygons using the results of \code{spatialCloneDominance()}
- `polygonAbundance`: Estimate clonal abundance inside polygons
- `polygonCentroids`: Calculate polygon centroids
- `polygonDiversity`: Estimate clonal diversity inside polygons
- `polygonPairwiseDistance`: Calculate distances between polygon centroids
- `polygonReceptorSummary`: Summarize columns in receptors data inside polygons
- `selectSpatialPolygons`: Select polygon vertices in an interactive app
- `seuratSubsetPolygon`: Subset a Seurat object to the spots inside polygons
- `spatialCloneDominance`: Calculate clonal dominance inside polygons
- `summarizePolygonDiversity`: Summarize polygon diversity at one value of q
- `withPolygons`: Apply a function to the receptors of each polygon

### Spatial statistics
- `plotRipleyCrossK`: Plot Ripley's cross K against distance
- `plotSpatialCloneJoinCount`: Plot a clone join-count result
- `plotSpatialLocalMoran`: Plot local Moran's I on a tissue image
- `spatialCloneJoinCount`: Test clone localization with join counts
- `spatialCloneSpread`: Summarize the spatial spread of clones
- `spatialCoordinateExtents`: Summarize spatial coordinate ranges
- `spatialCoordinateTable`: Get spatial plotting coordinates
- `spatialLee`: Calculate global Lee's L
- `spatialLocalMoran`: Calculate local Moran's I (LISA)
- `spatialMoran`: Calculate global Moran's I
- `spatialRipleyCrossK`: Calculate Ripley's cross K
